title: World Geography Trivia
description: Test your knowledge of countries, capitals, and landmarks around the world

questions.question: What is the capital of Australia?
questions.explanation: Canberra is the capital of Australia. Sydney is the largest city, but Canberra was chosen as a compromise between Sydney and Melbourne.

questions.question: Which is the longest river in the world?
questions.explanation: The Nile River in Africa is generally considered the longest river in the world at approximately 6,650 km (4,130 miles).

questions.question: How many continents are there?
questions.explanation: There are 7 continents: Africa, Antarctica, Asia, Australia/Oceania, Europe, North America, and South America.

questions.question: Which country has the most time zones?
questions.explanation: France has the most time zones (12) when counting all its overseas territories. Russia has 11 time zones within its contiguous territory.

questions.question: What is the smallest country in the world?
questions.explanation: Vatican City is the smallest country in the world with an area of approximately 0.44 square kilometers (0.17 square miles).

questions.question: Which desert is the largest in the world?
questions.explanation: The Antarctic Desert is the largest desert in the world. The Sahara is the largest hot desert.

questions.question: Mount Everest is located on the border between which two countries?
questions.explanation: Mount Everest, the world's highest mountain, is located on the border between Nepal and China (Tibet).

questions.question: What is the most populated city in the world?
questions.explanation: Tokyo, Japan is the most populated metropolitan area in the world with over 37 million people in its greater metro area.
